entries.descriptionOriginal: Battle chickens and dinosaurs, earn Gold, and upgrade your loadout. Face the Trike, giant rooster and T-Rex in the main arena, then take on progressively tougher expedition waves. Collect pets, equip them from your pet inventory, and use their bonuses in combat. Your saved Gold and previously owned pets carry over. Defeat creatures to earn Gold, then browse weapons and items in the shop. Open your pet inventory to equip owned pets and activate their bonuses. Prepare for escalating expedition waves. Trikes join the later waves.
